Senior Influencer Executive - Myprotein Japan Thehutgroup Manchester THG Nutrition 39 minutes THG Nutrition Manchester 39m About THG We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? About THG Nutrition: THG Nutrition is home to some of the best-loved and most trusted names in wellbeing and nutrition, including Myprotein, the world's largest online sports nutrition brand, its family of brands, Myvegan, Myvitamins & MP Activewear. We want to be the world's most empowering health movement, championing everyone to live healthier, more active lives. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries, to power and to empower those who want more. Everything we do is in-house, from manufacturing and new product development to content creation, e-commerce, marketing and logistics. This means we’re perfectly positioned to deliver to our vision and keep our place at the top of a fast-moving, global industry. It's an incredibly exciting time to join the team, and we’re always looking for talented people who share our vision and values to drive our Nutrition movement forward. Role: Senior Influencer Executive - Myprotein Japan Brand: Myprotein Employment: Full-time, Permanent Reporting to: Senior Marketing Manager Location: WeWork Offices in Tokyo and the Greater Tokyo Area About the Role Senior Influencer Executive - Myprotein Japan will be responsible for managing and growing our influencer partnerships to drive brand awareness, engagement, and sales. This role encompasses the full influencer lifecycle - from recruitment and relationship management to campaign execution and performance optimization. You will manage a diverse portfolio of influencers across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram while working under clear KPIs and budget management. Responsibilities: Research and discover influencer candidates in fitness, health, and nutrition fields Execute strategic outreach to achieve monthly influencer acquisition targets Negotiate contract terms with influencer candidates and optimize within budget constraints Handle onboarding processes including product sample shipping and brand guideline explanation Build and maintain strong relationships with existing influencer partners as primary point of contact Conduct regular check-ins to understand influencer needs and identify collaboration opportunities Coordinate influencer campaign briefs, timelines, and deliverables Review and approve influencer content to ensure brand alignment Register and update influencer information in internal systems Track performance metrics (engagement rate, reach, sales, etc.) and measure ROI Provide regular reporting in English (KPI achievement and budget execution status) Analyze data to identify top performers and optimization opportunities Monitor and manage influencer risks to ensure brand safety Develop influencer utilization strategies in collaboration with the marketing team Contribute to portfolio optimization balancing star, mid-tier, and emerging influencers Requirements: 3+ years of practical experience in influencer marketing, social media marketing, or related fields Deep understanding of major social media platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram) and the influencer ecosystem in Japan Knowledge and industry understanding of fitness, sports nutrition, and health fields Proven relationship management and communication skills Strategic approach and negotiation skills for influencer acquisition Ability to execute tasks based on clear KPIs and budget management skills Native-level Japanese (required): For communication with influencers and Japanese internal teams Business-level English reporting skills (required): For report creation and communication with global teams Data analysis and strategy development capabilities based on performance measurement Risk management awareness and problem-solving abilities Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with strong organizational
